verdict.rationale: LobeChat/LobeHub is an AI assistant and agent platform, which puts it in the MCP client role, so serving tools to other agents through its own MCP server is a different product role. The probe [lobe-chat-probe-4] points to lobehub.com/mcp, but that page is a marketplace directory of 100,000+ third-party MCP servers, not a first-party server that LobeHub runs. The desktop MCP connectors are client-side, and the lhm CLI only publishes marketplace listings. Neither shows LobeHub itself running as an MCP server, so the axis does not apply.
